-- Fix 74d (G1/G4) after 73d: the L1 cast already held, so the only change is to accept the new
-- published type in the contract. L1, L2 and the app are untouched.
update {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.L0_CONTRACT c
set TYPE_SQL = l.TYPE_SQL
from {{DEMO_L0}}.SYNC.V_COLS l
where l.TABLE_SCHEMA = 'MAINTENANCE' and l.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME and l.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME
  and c.TABLE_NAME = 'MAINT_NOTIFICATION' and c.COLUMN_NAME = 'DOWNTIMEHOURS';

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('74d', 'FIX_APPLIED', 'G1', 'Type change accepted in the contract; the L1 cast to NUMBER(10,2) kept L2 and the app unchanged', 'PRESENTER');
